start: Welcome to Dhoop Solar (धूप Solar) ☀️ Automated rooftop shade qualification for solar installers and PM Surya Ghar applicants. Send me a location pin: tap 📎 → Location → pick the spot.
help: 1) Send a location pin on the building. 2) I identify the roof and ray-cast seasonal sun exposure across a 1.5 m grid. 3) You get back usable roof area (m² / sq ft), suggested capacity (kWp), Rooftop Grade (A–D), and a 3D shadow time-lapse. /about explains how it works.
about: Dhoop Solar calculates rooftop solar viability by ray-casting sun positions across a 1.5 m rooftop grid against surrounding OpenStreetMap 3D buildings. It reports Grade A–D rating, unshaded usable roof area, and suggested system capacity. Note: Micro-obstructions like water tanks and parapets are confirmed during physical site inspection.
working: Simulating seasonal shadows over rooftop grid… (~45 s)
video_caption: Rooftop Solar Rating: Grade {grade} ({grade_title}) · {kwp} kWp suggested capacity.
not_modelled: Macro block shadows simulated from 3D map data. Rooftop water tanks, parapets, stair-heads, and trees require physical site verification.
limit_exceeded: You've hit the limit of 5 checks per hour. Try again a bit later.
overpass_busy: The map data service is busy. I'll retry in a moment.
no_buildings: I couldn't find buildings near that pin to evaluate rooftop shade. Try dropping the pin right on the building.
render_failed_notice: 3D video unavailable this time. Solar qualification numbers below are still valid.
